overview.description: The Global X PureCap MSCI Consumer Discretionary ETF (GXPD) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the MSCI USA / Consumer Discretionary index. The fund selects US companies involved in the Consumer Discretionary sector. Holdings are weighted purely by market capitalization without maximum weight constraints. GXPD was launched on Jul 22, 2025 and is issued by Global X.
